_about: Which weather station is nearest each lift, for the local-wind feature. UNVERIFIED: no lift or station coordinates were used; this is a judgement from the lift names and the station names (Western Weather Group stations: Siberia 8700, Belmont 8000, Funitel Top 7966, KT22 8000, Summit 8643, Roundhouse Top 7880, Scott Top 8120, Treeline Cirque Mid 7555, Sherwood 7115, Yellow Valve House 7640). Lower-mountain Palisades lifts have no usable station (the base station only exists for 2024-26) and are left out.
